Dhriti Sonthalia
I study economics and data science at Claremont McKenna College. Most of my work sits where valuation, education markets, and public data meet, and I care about making the numbers legible to people who didn’t build the model.

Resume (PDF) LinkedIn Email




Claremont, CA, by way of Hyderabad



Right now


Senior thesis. How board members’ financial expertise shapes a firm’s dividend payout policy.


PSYC167 project. What changed at U.S. colleges after the shift to test-optional admissions, told through College Scorecard data.


Girls Into VC. Running internal operations: chartering, budgets, and speaker events.



Experience


May – Jul 2026

Avendus Capital Analyst Intern, Mumbai
Built a three-statement model and DCF for 3M India, wrote and presented a 14-slide investment thesis, and tracked earnings and sector news for Indian listed equities.



Jan 2026 – present

CMC Girls Into VC Internal Operations Chair, Claremont
Manage the club’s chartering, compliance, and budgets, and run logistics for speaker events and programs.



Jun – Aug 2025

JV Ventures Analyst Intern, Hyderabad
Ran diligence on K-12 education infrastructure and pharma, and sized the GCC higher-education market for investment partners.



Sep 2024 – May 2025

Lowe Institute of Political Economy Data Journalist, Claremont
Analyzed firm-level and labor-market data in Stata and R on gender differences in CEO profit orientation, and turned the findings into public-facing charts.



Jun – Aug 2024

Sourcefin Strategic Consulting Intern, Johannesburg
Led a four-person team evaluating funding products for South African SMEs and pitched five recommendations to the executive committee and board.





Education
Claremont McKenna College B.A. Economics, Data Science Sequence. Expected May 2027.

Off the clock
I’m a professional Kathak dancer and a pianist. I also bake, play tennis, and travel whenever the calendar allows.
